name: LTX 2.3 3DReal — rough 3D render to photoreal (render-guided + audio)
title: Turn a rough 3D render photoreal
summary: Upload a rough grey 3D animation plus one finished-looking picture of its first frame; it turns the animation into realistic footage with the same camera move, and adds sound. Pick it to preview a 3D scene as if it had been filmed.
description:
Turn a rough 3D render into a photorealistic clip. Upload a rough 3D render as the source video and a reference image that sets the look; the render itself is the control the 3DREAL IC-LoRA reads (as in fal's own workflow for it), and the clip comes back photoreal with a matching audio track — keeping the render's motion, camera and layout, at the render's own frame rate. The graph adds the trigger word 3DREAL in front of the prompt, on both the typed and the AI-written path. The source is sliced to ~5 s. (Until 2026-11-04 this card fed a MoGe depth map of the render instead, and played a 30 fps render at 25 fps.)

Two prompt boxes: with "Enhance prompt with AI" OFF, the "Prompt (used as-is)" box drives generation. With it ON, the "Prompt (AI-enhanced)" box is rewritten by an in-graph LLM using your reference image. The inactive box is greyed out.

promptGuides.label: LTX IC-LoRA guide — Lightricks
promptGuides.tip: The trigger word 3DREAL is added for you: describe the photoreal look you want — materials, lighting, lens, atmosphere — and the sound; the layout and motion come from your render.

promptGuides.label: 3DREAL LoRA (fal) — trigger word and settings
promptGuides.tip: The trigger word 3DREAL is added for you: describe the real materials and light you want.
